incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: CSBU WorkMate opened, but the local CSBU WorkMate backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart CSBU WorkMate.

incompleteInstallation.title: CSBU WorkMate installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so CSBU WorkMate backend cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest CSBU WorkMate. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined CSBU WorkMate backend.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest CSBU WorkMate package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined CSBU WorkMate components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: CSBU WorkMate package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This CSBU WorkMate package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: CSBU WorkMate opened, but CSBU WorkMate backend stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling CSBU WorkMate may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

databaseNewerThanApp.title: A newer version of CSBU WorkMate is required
databaseNewerThanApp.description: Your local data was created by a newer version of CSBU WorkMate, and this version can't open it. Update CSBU WorkMate to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.
databaseNewerThanApp.descriptionWithVersion: Your local data was created by a version of CSBU WorkMate newer than the one installed now (v{{currentVersion}}), so this version can't open it. Update CSBU WorkMate to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: CSBU WorkMate opened, but CSBU WorkMate backend stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling CSBU WorkMate may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: CSBU WorkMate opened, but CSBU WorkMate backend could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart CSBU WorkMate.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: CSBU WorkMate detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, CSBU WorkMate will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: CSBU WorkMate is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another CSBU WorkMate startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart CSBU WorkMate.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: CSBU WorkMate backend is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: CSBU WorkMate backend couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
exited.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: CSBU WorkMate backend didn't finish starting within the expected time. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
portReportTimeout.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: CSBU WorkMate backend failed to start. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
startupFailed.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

crashRecovery.title: A previous crash was detected
crashRecovery.description: The app previously exited because of a native process crash. You can restart once in safe mode or continue normally. Safe mode only disables hardware acceleration and the desktop pet.
crashRecovery.openReportsFailed: Could not open the crash reports folder
crashRecovery.actionFailed: The recovery action failed. Please try again.
crashRecovery.restartFailed: Automatic restart is unavailable in development mode. Start manually with --safe-mode.

appCrash.title: Something went wrong
appCrash.description: The page hit an unexpected error. Your conversation history is still saved. Reload to continue.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.notifyBlocked: A task is blocked and needs you

extensionPanels.unavailable: This panel isn't available. CSBU WorkMate can only host a verified extension asset.
extensionPanels.loadFailed: This extension page could not be opened.

extensionReasonCodes.entry_point_integrity_declared_unchecked: This extension page requires an integrity check that this copy cannot provide, so it was not opened. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.signed_entry_point_integrity_declared_un: This signed extension page can only be opened from its verified installation. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.signed_snapshot_inconclusive: The extension's signed description could not be checked, so it was blocked for safety. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.verified_asset_invalid_snapshot: The extension's list of signed files is invalid. Reinstall the extension, or contact its publisher if this keeps happening.
extensionReasonCodes.verified_asset_not_listed: This file is not part of the extension's signed package, so it was not opened. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.verified_asset_missing: A file of this extension is missing from its installation. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.verified_asset_unreadable: A file of this extension could not be read safely, for example because it was replaced by a link. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.verified_asset_integrity_mismatch: A file of this extension was changed after it was installed. Reinstall the extension to restore the original files.
extensionReasonCodes.verified_asset_unavailable: Signed extension files cannot be opened on this platform.
extensionReasonCodes.theme_css_invalid_path: The extension's theme points to a file name that is not allowed. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.theme_css_not_utf8: The extension's theme file is not readable text. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.entry_point_integrity_declared_unchecked: This background service requires an integrity check that this copy cannot provide, so it was not started. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.signed_entry_point_integrity_declared_un: This signed background service can only start from its verified installation. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_root_missing: The verified installation of this extension is not available right now. Restart CSBU WorkMate; if it persists, reinstall the extension.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_invalid_snapshot: The extension's list of signed files is invalid, so the service was not started. Reinstall the extension or contact its publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_signed_snapshot_inconclusi: The signed description of this service is incomplete or ambiguous, so it was not started. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_integrity_required: This service is not covered by the extension's signature, so it was not started. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_entry_mismatch: The service does not match its signed description, so it was not started. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_entry_missing: The service's program file is missing from the installation. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_entry_unreadable: The service's program file could not be read safely. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_integrity_mismatch: The service's program file was changed after installation, so it was not started. Reinstall the extension to restore it.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_verified_read_unavailable: Signed background services cannot be started on this platform.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_runtime_required: This service does not say how it should run, so it was not started. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_runtime_unsupported: This service needs a runtime that CSBU WorkMate does not provide for extensions. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_shell_script_unsupported: Shell-script services are not allowed for signed extensions. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_native_unsupported: Native program services are not allowed for extensions. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_entry_kind_unsupported: The service's program file is not a supported script type. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_capabilities_unavailable: This service needs extra permissions that this version of CSBU WorkMate cannot grant yet. Update the app when a newer version is available.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_runtime_requires_signed_fi: This service can only run from a signed installation. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.bound_service_runner_unavailable: This service is verified, but running extension services is not enabled in this version of CSBU WorkMate.
extensionReasonCodes.integrity_binding_unavailable: This extension command cannot run because its signed installation could not be verified. Reinstall the extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.handler_integrity_checked: The command's code was verified. Running extension code is not enabled in this version, so nothing was executed.
extensionReasonCodes.name_reserved_by_builtin: This extension is built into CSBU WorkMate and is updated together with the app. Update the app instead.
extensionReasonCodes.curated_install_refused: This extension is not approved for installation here. Choose a curated extension or ask your administrator.
extensionReasonCodes.curated_not_in_index: This extension is not listed in the WorkMate hub. Refresh the hub and try again.
extensionReasonCodes.curated_not_curated: Only curated or built-in extensions can be installed. Choose a curated extension from the WorkMate hub.
extensionReasonCodes.curated_not_allowlisted: This extension is not on your organisation's allowed list. Ask your administrator to allow it.
extensionReasonCodes.curated_integrity_missing: The hub entry for this extension has no integrity value, so it cannot be verified. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.curated_integrity_mismatch: The extension's files do not match the hub listing. Refresh the hub and try again, or contact the publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.curated_signature_required: This installation only accepts signed extensions, and this one is not signed. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.curated_signature_missing_key_id: The extension's signature does not say which key signed it. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.curated_signature_invalid: The extension's signature is not valid. Do not install it; contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.curated_unknown_key: The extension was signed by a key this installation does not trust. Ask your administrator.
extensionReasonCodes.curated_key_config_invalid: The trusted signing keys are configured incorrectly. Ask your administrator to fix the configuration.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_manifest_limit: The extension's description is too large to be accepted. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_metadata_limit: The extension's signing information is too large to be accepted. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_invalid_identity: The extension's name or version is not valid. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_not_allowlisted: This extension is not on your organisation's allowed list. Ask your administrator to allow it.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_missing_key_id: The extension's signature does not say which key signed it. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_invalid_key_id: The extension's signing key name is not valid. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_unknown_key: The extension was signed by a key this installation does not trust. Ask your administrator.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_missing_integrity: The extension's listing has no integrity value, so it cannot be verified. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_invalid_integrity: The extension's integrity value is malformed. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_integrity_mismatch: The extension's description does not match its signed listing. Refresh the hub and try again, or contact the publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_missing_signature: This extension is not signed, and only signed extensions are accepted. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_invalid_signature: The extension's signature is not valid. Do not install it; contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_invalid_manifest: The extension's description is not valid. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.signature_identity_mismatch: The extension's name or version does not match its signed listing. Refresh the hub and try again, or contact the publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_invalid: The extension package is damaged or not a valid package. Download it again or contact the publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_limit_exceeded: The extension package is too large or has too many files. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_unsafe_entry_name: The extension package contains a file name that is not allowed on this system. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_duplicate_entry: The extension package contains the same file twice. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_symlink_or_special_entry: The extension package contains links or special files, which are not allowed. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_entry_not_covered_by_signature: The extension package contains files that are not covered by its signature. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_covered_file_missing: A signed file is missing from the extension package. Download it again or contact the publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_invalid_covered_path: The extension lists a file name that is not allowed. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_conflicting_covered_digest: The extension lists the same file with two different integrity values. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_manifest_mismatch: The description inside the package differs from the signed one. Download it again or contact the publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_integrity_mismatch: A file in the extension package does not match its signature. Download it again; do not install a modified package.
extensionReasonCodes.package_invalid_dir_name: The extension's name or version cannot be stored on this system. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.package_case_collision: Another installed extension or version has the same name apart from upper and lower case. Remove it first, then try again.
extensionReasonCodes.package_place_failed: The extension could not be put in place. Nothing was changed; try again.
extensionReasonCodes.package_version_slot_blocked: Something unexpected is in the way of this extension version. Remove the extension and install it again.
extensionReasonCodes.package_downgrade_refused: A newer version of this extension is already installed. Older versions are not installed automatically.
extensionReasonCodes.package_marker_write_failed: The installation could not be completed. Nothing was changed; check free disk space and try again.
extensionReasonCodes.package_parent_not_directory: The extensions folder of CSBU WorkMate is not usable. Restart the app; if it persists, contact support.
extensionReasonCodes.package_remove_failed: The extension could not be removed completely. Close anything using it, restart CSBU WorkMate and try again.
extensionReasonCodes.package_root_create_failed: The extension folder could not be created. Check free disk space and permissions, then try again.
extensionReasonCodes.package_write_failed: The extension files could not be written. Check free disk space, then try again.
extensionReasonCodes.package_retain_failed: The extension was installed but could not be activated. Restart CSBU WorkMate.
extensionReasonCodes.package_unsupported_platform: Signed extensions cannot be installed on this platform.
extensionReasonCodes.agent_tool_not_plan_safe: This tool can make changes, and extension tools that make changes cannot run in this version of CSBU WorkMate.
extensionReasonCodes.hub_package_not_found: The extension's files were not found in the hub folder. Refresh the hub list and try again.
extensionReasonCodes.hub_verification_failed: The extension's description file is invalid, so it was not installed. Contact the extension's publisher.
extensionReasonCodes.hub_not_installed: This extension is not installed, so it cannot be updated. Install it first.
extensionReasonCodes.hub_remove_failed: The extension could not be removed completely. Close anything that uses it and try again.
extensionReasonCodes.package_lifecycle_hooks_refused: This extension asks to run setup programs, which signed extensions cannot do. Contact the extension's publisher.
